relevant_changes.title: Excellence Hubs
relevant_changes.territory: EU; coordinators limited to Widening countries; non-Widening entities may join if necessary for expected impacts
relevant_changes.beneficiaries: Consortia involving at least two R&I ecosystems from two different Widening countries; each ecosystem must cover academia, business, public authority and societal actors. Non-Widening legal entities may participate when justified.
relevant_changes.funds: Joint R&I strategies, academia-business collaboration, R&I pilot projects, investment plans, knowledge transfer, skills, secondments and staff exchanges. Pilots/demonstrators themselves must be financed by sources other than the Excellence Hub EU contribution.
constraints: Coordinator must be established in a Widening country
At least two ecosystems from two different Widening countries
Each Widening ecosystem must include four actor categories
30% co-financing must be secured and explained
Italian participation must be justified as necessary for expected impacts
relevant_changes.recommendation: For Meridionale Impianti, pursue only as an industrial/technology partner in a consortium led by Widening-country ecosystems, preferably on energy, industrial digitalisation, automation, IoT or deep-tech deployment.

notes: No other material changes detected versus the previous radar state in the eight monitored official sources. EIC Accelerator has a previously known batching date on 2026-09-02 at 17:00 Brussels time.
